title: fathom
pitch: submarine duel against a computer with opinions. every miss tells you how close you were. decoys lie.
controls: tap or click the enemy sea to fire. arrow keys + enter also fire, s toggles sonar. drag subs to move, tap to rotate. modes: classic or salvo.
changelog: v2: three rivals with voices (dial-up, screensaver, root), salvo mode (one shot per surviving sub), spoiler-free daily share, forfeit counts as a loss (with confirm), enter-key and card fixes.
